source: World Bank World Development Indicators (source 2), official API

infant.unit: deaths before age 1 per 1,000 live births

u5.unit: deaths before age 5 per 1,000 live births

adultMale.unit: probability of dying between ages 15 and 60 per 1,000 male adults aged 15

adultFemale.unit: probability of dying between ages 15 and 60 per 1,000 female adults aged 15

lifeMale.unit: years of life expectancy at birth, male

lifeFemale.unit: years of life expectancy at birth, female

missing: null; model estimates are separate from observations
